themeCards.title: Core CPI ran 0.1 percentage point above forecast into a September hike
themeCards.fact: BLS: August CPI rose 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y; core rose 0.3% m/m and 2.4% y/y; energy rose 16.3% y/y and gasoline rose 3.9% m/m. CNBC: headline CPI was in line with estimates, and the 0.3% core monthly gain was 0.1 percentage point higher than forecast. U.S. Treasury: the official 11 September curve printed 4.63% on the 2-year, 4.96% on the 10-year, and 5.35% on the 30-year. WTOP AP: the S&P 500 closed at 7,656.98, up 0.9%, and broke a four-day losing streak.
themeCards.mechanism: The 10-year is now pricing 4.96% against a 0.3% core CPI monthly gain that ran 0.1 percentage point above forecast, so the change is a core beat that marked the long end cheaper next to a 4.63% 2-year. A 0.3% core print, 0.1 above forecast, transmitted into the official 4.96% 10-year and from there into the 7,656.98 S&P close, up 0.9%, which is the UST and US equities sleeve. The read retires if BLS reprints core CPI below 0.3% m/m. Horizon is days, ending at the FOMC decision.
themeCards.trigger: BLS core CPI reprinting above 0.3% m/m.
themeCards.invalidator: BLS core CPI reprinting below 0.3% m/m.

themeCards.title: Saudi shut the East-West bypass and oil jumped Monday
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: Brent’s November contract settled Friday at 104.61. 财经早茶 能源: crude eased Friday then jumped more than 3% in Monday Asia after Saudi closed an important pipeline used to bypass Hormuz, and the Iran-Gulf meeting on a temporary Hormuz lane was postponed. 律动: Saudi shut the East-West line after attacks, calling it a precaution, with no restart timetable.
themeCards.mechanism: Brent is now pricing 104.61 as Friday's November settle against a Monday Asia jump of more than 3% after Saudi shut the East-West bypass, so the change is a supply-floor bid with no restart timetable. Friday's 104.61 settle transmitted into Monday's jump after the East- West shut, which is the Oil exposure. The read retires if 华尔街见闻 reprints Brent below 104.61 after an East- West restart. Horizon is weeks, ending when Saudi names a restart timetable for the East-West line.
themeCards.trigger: Brent reprinting above 104.61 while East-West stays shut.
themeCards.invalidator: Brent reprinting below 104.61 after an East-West restart.

themeCards.title: Overnight reverse repos started at 5040亿元 with the 7-day at zero
themeCards.fact: PBOC: 14 September 7-day reverse repos were 0亿元 and overnight reverse repos were 5040亿元.       新华财经: Shanghai closed Friday at 3888.11, down 1.18%; Shenzhen at 13471.26, down 1.08%; ChiNext at 3322.04. 东方财富: Hang Seng closed Friday at 24805.63, down 0.6%. 第一财经: overnight reverse repos run 14–17 September with a daily cap of 6000亿元, and scheduled government-bond payments are 5780亿元 on 14–18 September.
themeCards.mechanism: Shanghai is now pricing 3888.11, down 1.18%, against 5040亿元 of overnight reverse repos and 0亿元 of 7-day reverse repos, so the change is an A-share close that absorbed a tax-period liquidity backstop. A 5040亿元 overnight print against a 6000亿元 cap transmitted through 5780亿元 of scheduled government-bond payments into the 3888.11 Shanghai close, down 1.18%, and Hang Seng at 24805.63, down 0.6%, which is the A/H shares and CGBs exposure. The read retires if PBOC reprints overnight reverse repos at 0亿元 while Shanghai reprints below 3888.11. Horizon is days, ending when overnight reverse repos finish the 14–17 September window.
themeCards.trigger: PBOC overnight reverse repos reprinting at the 6000亿元 cap with Shanghai holding 3888.11.
themeCards.invalidator: PBOC overnight reverse repos reprinting at 0亿元, or Shanghai reprinting below 3888.11.

themeCards.title: Traders cut large euro-area hike bets and Stoxx bounced
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: the Stoxx 600 closed at 639.10, up 0.49%, and the DAX closed at 25553.00, up 0.88%. 财经早茶 欧洲股债: traders cut large euro-area hike bets, short-end government bonds rose, and European stocks rebounded. 财经早茶: Lagarde said euro-area inflation will stay high for a while and AI asset valuations are very high.
themeCards.mechanism: The Stoxx 600 is now pricing 639.10, up 0.49%, against a DAX close at 25553.00, up 0.88%, so the change is a rebound as traders cut large euro-area hike bets. A 639.10 Stoxx bounce transmitted through rising short-end government bonds into the 25553.00 DAX close, which is the EU equities and Bunds exposure. The read retires if 华尔街见闻 reprints the Stoxx 600 below 639.10. Horizon is days, ending at the next Lagarde remarks on euro-area inflation.

themeCards.title: Gold held 4408.90 while bitcoin lost the 7.7万美元 handle
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: COMEX gold closed at 4408.90 and spot gold at 4349.06. 华尔街见闻: bitcoin was 77439.13 on Friday. 律动: HTX printed 7.672万美元 on Monday, below 7.7万美元.
themeCards.mechanism: COMEX gold is now pricing 4408.90 against spot at 4349.06, with HTX bitcoin at 7.672万美元 below the 7.7万美元 handle, so the change is gold holding while BTC lost Friday's 77439.13 print. A 4408.90 COMEX close transmitted into the 7.672万美元 HTX print, which is the Gold and BTC exposure. The read retires if 律动 reprints HTX bitcoin back above 7.7万美元. Horizon is days, ending at the FOMC decision.
themeCards.invalidator: HTX bitcoin reprinting below 7.672万美元, or COMEX gold reprinting below 4408.90.

themeCards.mechanism: 智谱 H-shares are now pricing a 156.64亿港元 placing at 714港元 against 201.4亿元 of 2027 zero-coupon convertibles, so the change is listed-AI funding into Xi's BRICS open-source zone. themeCards.invalidator: 智谱 placing reprinting below 156.64亿港元.

沙特在遭到多次袭击后关闭了用于绕开霍尔木兹海峡的一条重要输油管道。伊朗与多个海湾国家原定周一就开辟霍尔木兹海峡临时航道举行的会议也已推迟。布伦特原油周一亚洲盘初应声上涨逾3%

金砖国家峰会联合声明呼吁中东各方保持克制，避免采取可能进一步加剧紧张局势的行动。伊朗总统在峰会期间发表强硬讲话，强调伊朗人民不会屈服，“如果美国逼迫我们，我们就会反击”

美国联邦政府本财年前11个月预算赤字升至有记录以来最高水平之一，净利息支出超过国防支出等多数主要支出类别
